summary: CR-072 Inventory Management Module - Full E2E testing completed. Fixed critical bug: Inventory section was missing from sidebar (VISIBLE_SECTIONS didn't include 'inventory'). After fix, all 21 test cases passed. 5 screens tested: Stock Dashboard (/inventory), Purchase Entry (/inventory-purchase), Physical Count (/inventory-physical), Inventory Setup (/inventory-setup with 3 tabs), Recipes (/recipes with 3 tabs). All API integrations working with preprod.mygenie.online backend.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Sidebar.jsx VISIBLE_SECTIONS was missing 'inventory' - added it to make Inventory section visible in sidebar
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing across all 5 inventory screens
API integration working correctly - stock-inventory returns 427 items, ingredients returns 429 items, recipes returns 64/11/7 for standard/sub/addon
Sidebar flyout correctly shows 5 sub-items: Stock Dashboard, Purchase Entry, Physical Count, Ingredients & Setup, Recipes

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend only - external Laravel backend at preprod.mygenie.online)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - all tests used existing live data from 18March restaurant
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-072 Inventory Management module is fully functional after sidebar fix. Login takes ~10 seconds to complete loading page. Stock-inventory API takes ~11 seconds to respond (234KB, 427 items). Sidebar is collapsed by default; Inventory icon (Package) requires CLICK to show flyout with 5 sub-items. All inventory pages load correctly: /inventory (Stock Dashboard with 4 KPIs, stock table with filters), /inventory-setup (3 tabs: Ingredients 429 items with 31 categories, Vendors 5 types, Wastage 4 reasons), /inventory-purchase (purchase form with line items), /inventory-physical (physical count with drift calculation), /recipes (3 tabs: Standard 64, Sub 11, Addon 7 recipes with create form).

rca_of_the_issue: The Inventory section was not visible in the sidebar because the VISIBLE_SECTIONS constant in Sidebar.jsx did not include 'inventory'. The sidebarMenuItems array correctly defined the inventory section with 5 children, but the filter at line 290-295 was excluding it. Fixed by adding 'inventory' to VISIBLE_SECTIONS set.
